data.headline: BHR’s EDGAR record lists a PREC14A filing

claims.text: BHR’s EDGAR filing record lists a PREC14A filing dated 2026-10-14 and describes its primary document as BRANCOUS LP1 - PREC14A.

citation.quote:
Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. (CIK 0001574085) EDGAR filing record:
"form": "PREC14A"
"filingDate": "2026-10-14"
"accessionNumber": "0001096906-26-001545"
"primaryDocDescription": "BRANCOUS LP1 - PREC14A"

claims.text: The 10-K ties Item 11 information to a definitive proxy statement filed under Regulation 14A.

citation.quote: The information required in response to this Item 11 is incorporated herein by reference to our definitive proxy statement to be filed with the SEC pursuant to Regulation 14A promulgated under the Exchange Act not later than 120 days after the end of the fiscal year covered by this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

claims.text: The 10-K also ties Item 12 information to a definitive proxy statement filed under Regulation 14A.

citation.quote: The information required in response to this Item 12 is incorporated herein by reference to our definitive proxy statement to be filed with the SEC pursuant to Regulation 14A promulgated under the Exchange Act not later than 120 days after the end of the fiscal year covered by this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

claims.text: The 10-K likewise directs Item 13 information to a definitive proxy statement filed under Regulation 14A.

citation.quote: The information required in response to this Item 13 is incorporated herein by reference to our definitive proxy statement to be filed with the SEC pursuant to Regulation 14A promulgated under the Exchange Act not later than 120 days after the end of the fiscal year covered by this Annual Report on Form 10-K.
